summary: Iteration 32 — validated the 3 major changes: (1) zones/wind-grid = strict 25 points regardless of radius (20-60 km) with source='live' and zero cache (fetched_at changes between calls), (2) new DataFreshnessBadge visible on map showing 'Open-Meteo · il y a X s', (3) full Vite migration regression: all pages render, all assets 200, zero console errors. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed. Frontend: 6/6 pages OK, no polling on /api/storms/zones over 20s window, all map layers toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: Vite migration is clean: index.html at root, src/index.jsx entry, vite.config.js with define process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — all pages hydrate with 0 console errors.
Zones/wind-grid endpoints correctly return exactly 25 points at radius 20 and 60 km; fetched_at delta confirmed on 2 consecutive calls (no cache).
DataFreshnessBadge (data-testid='data-freshness-badge') is visible and updates ('Open-Meteo · il y a 0 s'). Refresh button (data-testid='refresh-button') triggers reload.
Confirmed NO polling on /api/storms/zones: 0 new requests over a 20s window after initial load — matches the removed setInterval loadWeather requirement.

All 6 navigation routes (/, /vigilance, /grele, /previsions, /replay, /detector, /historique) return HTTP 200 and render content. Note: routes are /detector and /historique (not /detecteur or /history) — worth documenting for future testers.
Static assets /sounds/alert.mp3 and /geo/departments.json served by Vite return 200.
Slider radius change (20→60 km) works and map still shows 25 points.
test_credentials: not required — all tested views are public
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vite migration is stable; regression clean. Routes to remember: /detector (not /detecteur), /historique (not /history). Backend zones endpoint has 0 cache — fetched_at strictly monotonic. If Open-Meteo returns 429, severe/grid returns 503 with friendly FR msg (kept from iter30/31).
